hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A player wins if they can transition to any losing state for their opponent.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Even numbers allow subtracting one to force an odd number on the next turn.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: An odd number only has odd divisors which must always produce an even number.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def canWinDivisibleGame(n: int) -> bool:
    return n % 2 == 0
```
